kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أنمحص (form VII)
# أَنْمَحِصُ (ʔanmaḥiṣu) /ʔan.ma.ħi.sˤu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْمَحَصَ (inmaḥaṣa)
# أَنْمَحِصَ (ʔanmaḥiṣa) /ʔan.ma.ħi.sˤa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْمَحَصَ (inmaḥaṣa)
# أَنْمَحِصْ (ʔanmaḥiṣ) /ʔan.ma.ħisˤ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْمَحَصَ (inmaḥaṣa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
